_source: Bangkok inner-zone truck ban as commonly published (police/BMA announcements). VERIFY against the official announcement before final analysis; some roads/expressways have different rules.
_note: Classifier cannot reliably separate 6 vs 10 wheels at 352x288, so the main analysis treats every heavy truck with the 6-wheel windows (which every 10-wheel truck must also obey). truck10 windows are reported separately using the unvalidated zero-shot sub-type.
